messages:
maya: Heads-up — a bunch of us-west-3 GPU nodes are stuck in PROVISIONING. Started ~11:44 UTC after the role-boundary change last night. Provisioner logs show: `AccessDenied: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity` when trying to get ephemeral creds.

rico: Ugh. That matches the IAM change I reviewed. Did the new boundary accidentally block the cluster service account? @linh?

linh: I pushed the tighter role-boundary policy to limit cross-account assume to tag:env=prod only. I thought node SAs were tagged, but looks like ours weren't. Rolling a quick rollback to allow the gpu provisioner SA.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollback started for iam/policies/ephemeral-gpu-role (PR #4129) at 12:01 UTC

maya: Also noticing audit logs for the same timeframe are thin for us-west-3. Flow logs and auditshipper show sampling bumped to 0.05 during the firewall change window and the audit-shipper was scoped to privnet, so some VPC+STS audit lines were dropped.

devin: Confirmed — firewall rule 172.31.0.0/16 deny was applied to the audit-shipper egress during the rollout. We're restoring the shipper allowlist now and will reingest missing ranges.

linh: Rollback is applied for the role-boundary. Nodes still need a fresh token — metadata server cached the deny for a few seconds and the prov job timed out. Quick fix: restart the provisioning job pods so they re-try with the restored policy.

rico: Command to run in infra-provisioning namespace: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/gpu-provisioner -n infra-provisioning` — that'll force re-acquire of tokens.

maya: Running it now. Also kicked off s3 reingest of dropped audit chunks: `audit-reingest --region us-west-3 --start 2024-06-12T11:40Z --end 2024-06-12T12:10Z` (queued).

maya: Quick cost note: the retry loop in the failed window consumed ~120 GPU-minutes in us-west-3 (est. ~$80 extra). Finance FYI.

devin: We should add a CI gate: role-boundary policy rollouts must include an allowlist test against cluster SA ARNs. I'll open a PR to add that to infra-policy-tests.

linh: Agreed. Also will make the firewall rollout include an audit-shipper smoke check (validate flow logs reach s3 within 60s).

ops-bot: incident:resolved 1715809999 — nodes started and pool capacity back to normal at 12:15 UTC. Backfill job for missing audit logs queued. Follow-up: schedule a short postmortem and add rollout checks.

rico: TL;DR: root cause = role-boundary tighten + firewall scoping during rollout. Fix = rollback + restart provisioner + audit reingest. Follow-ups: CI gating for role-boundary, firewall preflight for audit-shipper, cost chargeback note.

maya: I'll file the postmortem draft and tag SRE/Platform/Security. Thanks y'all. :thumbsup:
